<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  function getFormType(path, form) {
    var name = ((form && form.getAttribute('name')) || '').toLowerCase();
    if (path.indexOf('custom-matcha-blends') > -1 || name.indexOf('custom blend') > -1) return 'custom_blend_brief';
    if (path.indexOf('sample') > -1) return 'sample_request';
    if (path.indexOf('pricelist') > -1) return 'pricelist_request';
    return 'contact_form';
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.w-form form').forEach(function (form) {
    var wrapper = form.closest('.w-form');
    var success = wrapper && wrapper.querySelector('.w-form-done');
    if (!success) return;

    var observer;
    var pending = false;
    var sent = false;

    function trackWhenSuccessful() {
      if (!pending || sent || typeof gtag === 'undefined') return;

      var isVisible =
        success.offsetParent !== null &&
        window.getComputedStyle(success).display !== 'none';

      if (!isVisible) return;

      sent = true;
      pending = false;

      var path = window.location.pathname;
      var language =
        document.documentElement.lang ||
        (path.indexOf('/es') === 0 ? 'es' : path.indexOf('/de') === 0 ? 'de' : 'en');

      gtag('event', 'form_submission', {
        form_type: getFormType(path, form),
        page_path: path,
        language: language,
        event_id: 'pmp_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)
      });

      if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
      pending = true;
      sent = false;

      if (observer) observer.disconnect();

      observer = new MutationObserver(trackWhenSuccessful);
      observer.observe(success, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
      });

      window.setTimeout(trackWhenSuccessful, 0);
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        pending = false;
        if (observer) observer.disconnect();
      }, 30000);
    });
  });
});
</script>
